svg.title: PCGA Day 3 — HITL, Guardrails and Action Queue UI: Technical Flow
svg.desc: Hour-by-hour technical flow for Day 3, from the guardrail pipeline through the HITL action queue backend, Action Queue UI, Activity Log, and end-of-day checkpoint.
svg.text: Applies to: risk_assessment, letter_draft, legal_finding — every sub-agent output passes through before reaching the user or actions table
Hours 2–3 — HITL action queue backend (6 endpoints)
Purpose: makes system observable. Primary debugging tool for Days 4–5. Every step the orchestrator took is now visible.

g.text: Upload contract → analyse → pending action appears in queue → review reasoning → edit draft
→ approve with double confirm → real email sent. Activity Log shows every agent step.
